dropped_note: No finding was dropped as wrong. All 18 high findings were verified against file:line. 'kept-modified' means the defect stands but the proposed fix was changed; 'deferred' means a valid finding left for a bead or later.

lens_verdicts.newcomer-ts: Low level strong; rasl task in ~40 lines; problems are vocabulary and placement, plus one real bug (handed-text checks).
lens_verdicts.newcomer-py: Task in ~50 lines, ran first time; handle level good; cross-layer naming, verb homes, flat namespace, text-only input are the gaps.
lens_verdicts.idiom-ts: Careful strict TS; types do not carry kinds; layers named separately; I-prefix and factory names off-ecosystem.
lens_verdicts.idiom-py: Mostly idiomatic; TS shows through where Python mirrors member by member with no Python-wide rule (UTF-16, kinds, errors, namespace).
lens_verdicts.cross-layer: Each layer coherent alone; seams show in vocabulary, processor role and error grouping.
lens_verdicts.cross-binding: Close parity, but no neutral spec, hand-copied lists, and corpora gaps that let two real differences through.
